title: 第四课 · 请问您贵姓 / 你认识不认识他
subtitle: Lesson 4 — 请问您贵姓 · May I know your name? + Introductions (textbook + workbook)

items.en: to look after, to take care of

items.py: Tā bú shì lǎoshī, tā shì xuésheng.
items.en: She is not a teacher, she is a student.

items.py: Mǎlì: Nǐ rènshi bú rènshi tā?

items.zh: 大卫：认识，他是我们老师。
items.py: Dàwèi: Rènshi, tā shì wǒmen lǎoshī.

items.zh: 大卫：他叫张华。我介绍一下。
items.py: Dàwèi: Tā jiào Zhāng Huá. Wǒ jièshào yíxià.
items.en: David: His name is Zhang Hua. Let me introduce you.

items.zh: 大卫：张老师，这是我朋友玛丽。
items.py: Dàwèi: Zhāng lǎoshī, zhè shì wǒ péngyou Mǎlì.
items.en: David: Teacher Zhang, this is my friend Mary.

items.zh: 张华：你好！认识你很高兴。
items.py: Zhāng Huá: Nǐ hǎo! Rènshi nǐ hěn gāoxìng.
items.en: Zhang Hua: Hello! Nice to meet you.

items.zh: 玛丽：认识你我也很高兴。
items.py: Mǎlì: Rènshi nǐ wǒ yě hěn gāoxìng.
items.en: Mary: Nice to meet you too.
Kazuko: May I ask your surname?

items.py: Wáng xiānsheng: Wǒ xìng Wáng, jiào Wáng Yīng.
items.en: Mr. Wang: My surname is Wang, my name is Wang Ying.

items.py: Hézǐ: Zhè shì wǒ de míngpiàn.
items.en: Kazuko: This is my business card.

items.py: Wáng xiānsheng: Xièxie. Zhè shì wǒ de.
items.en: Mr. Wang: Thank you. Here is mine.
Mr. Wang: Please look after me.

data.topic: 替换与扩展 · Substitution & Extension (textbook L4)

items.py: Nǐ rènshi bú rènshi tā? —— Rènshi.

items.zh: 你认识不认识她？——不认识。
items.py: Nǐ rènshi bú rènshi tā? —— Bú rènshi.
Tā shì shéi? —— Tā shì Zhāng lǎoshī.
items.en: Who is he? —— He's Teacher Zhang.

items.zh: 她叫什么名字？——她叫和子。
items.py: Tā jiào shénme míngzi? —— Tā jiào Hézǐ.
items.en: What's her name? —— Her name is Kazuko.

items.py: Nín guì xìng? —— Wǒ xìng Lǐ.
items.en: What's your surname? —— My surname is Li.

items.zh: A: 我不认识那个人，她叫什么？
items.py: A: Wǒ bú rènshi nà ge rén, tā jiào shénme?
items.en: A: I don't know that person, what's her name?

items.py: A: Tā shì Měiguó rén ma?
B: Shì, tā shì Měiguó rén.

items.en: Do you know him? (V + 不 + V question pattern)
Let me introduce briefly. (V + 一下 softens request)
Please sit for a moment. (V + 一下)

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (textbook L4: 吗, interrogative pronouns, adjective predicates)

items.zh: 你是学生吗？——是，我是学生。
items.py: Nǐ shì xuésheng ma? —— Shì, wǒ shì xuésheng.
items.en: Are you a student? — Yes. (吗 question: statement + 吗)

items.py: Tā máng ma? —— Tā hěn máng.
items.en: Is he busy? — He's very busy. (吗 question)

items.py: Tā xìng shénme? —— Tā xìng Wáng.
items.en: What's her surname? — Her surname is Wang. (什么 question)

items.py: Tā shì shéi? —— Tā shì wǒ lǎoshī.
items.en: Who is he? — He's my teacher. (谁 question)

items.zh: 你叫什么名字？——我叫大卫。
items.py: Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi? —— Wǒ jiào Dàwèi.
items.en: What's your name? — My name is David. (什么 question)
He is very happy. (adjectival predicate: subject + 很 + adj)

items.py: Tā shì shéi? —— Tā shì Wáng xiānsheng.
items.en: Who is he? —— He's Mr. Wang.

items.zh: 她妹妹也是学生，她不太忙。
items.py: Tā mèimei yě shì xuésheng, tā bú tài máng.
items.en: Her younger sister is also a student, she's not too busy.

items.zh: 他们身体都很好，工作也很忙。
items.py: Tāmen shēntǐ dōu hěn hǎo, gōngzuò yě hěn máng.
items.en: They are all in good health, and also very busy with work.
